ios.desc:
Leave just one peg. Play classic Peg Solitaire across 120+ levels, offline and without ads.

Jump a peg over its neighbour into an empty space to remove the peg in between. The rules are simple; finding the right sequence is the challenge.

LEARN BY PLAYING
An interactive tutorial shows you how to play. Tap a peg to highlight its available moves, then choose where to jump.

EXPLORE ANOTHER SOLUTION
Undo and redo moves to try a different approach. Restart a board or return to an unfinished game later.

PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE
• 120+ levels with different board layouts
• Offline play
• Undo, redo and saved games
• Light and dark themes

A clean interface and a custom font made for Pegma keep the focus on the board.

FREE AND OPEN SOURCE
No ads. No in-app purchases.

Can you leave only one peg?

show_hn.title: Show HN: Pegma, an open-source version of the classic Peg solitaire

quotes.text:
Discover Pegma, the free and open-source version of the classic Peg solitaire game! Pegma offers a clean, minimal design and smooth gameplay across multiple platforms.

Key features:

Fully open-source code available on GitHub, inviting community contributions and transparency

Custom-designed font created by the developer to enhance the game’s unique style

Cross-platform support: play on iOS, Android

Lightweight, intuitive interface that stays true to the timeless puzzle mechanics

Try it now:

Website: https://pegma.vercel.app

GitHub: https://github.com/khlebobul/pegma

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/ru/app/pegma-peg-solitaire/id6754343848

Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.khlebobul.pegma

If you appreciate open-source projects and classic brain teasers, Pegma is definitely worth checking out!
